description: How the six-card pyramid tarot spread works: what each position means, how to lay it out, how to read the layers, and a worked example.
lede: The pyramid tarot spread builds from a base of three cards to a single card at the top. It suits questions about what to do next.

layout.alt: A pyramid tarot spread of six numbered cards. The bottom row, left to right, has card 1 What is happening, card 2 What is in the way and card 3 What helps. The middle row has card 4 What you can do and card 5 What to let go. Card 6 Likely direction sits alone at the top.
layout.caption: Read the base row left to right, then the middle row, then the top card. Each row narrows toward the likely direction.
